inputs.name: hand over from Training Pipeline to Model Evaluation Harness

output.level_0: The training job crashes before metrics are written, so the evaluation harness never receives any input at all.
output.level_1: No mechanism exists to pass trained model artifacts to the evaluation harness, so testing happens nowhere.
output.level_2: A team member manually copies model files to a shared drive and runs evaluation scripts by hand.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically triggers the evaluation harness whenever a new model artifact is produced and validated.
output.level_4: The handover is governed by policy checks that verify model lineage and approval status before evaluation begins.
